scope: Current /conversion browser workflow, public session/conversion/file API, and API lifecycle behavior affecting conversion and retrieval. Includes browser, separately started API, and focused in-process environments.
excluded: Old synchronous upload flow as active behavior; its retired upload and read routes are covered only as 404 boundaries.
Implementation plans, infrastructure setup, generic UI primitives, telemetry, and future distributed processing.
documentedLimitations: Reload or a new tab cannot resume a batch because browser credentials are not persisted.
Page-exit cancellation is best effort; conversion continues if it is lost.
Sharp/native and HEIC work lack hard wall-clock termination.
The current design runs one API process per storage root.
